title: AuthorizedElderListV1
description: Paginated elders the caller may access in the requested mode, returned by GET /api/v1/me/authorized-elders. The server filters by role, care unit, assignment, relationship and validity window; document 10 section 4.6 forbids any client filter from widening that set.

DailySummarySnapshot.description: Current-day PROFESSIONAL_DAILY metadata in Elder.timezone. summary=null means no visible summary, including hidden non-formal rows; it does not prove no draft exists. Non-formal states require summary:review in addition to summary:read. as_of fixes the calendar day, not a historical version snapshot.

InteractionMetrics.description: Professional voice_session:read metadata snapshot. Each COMPLETED session with a completed SUCCESS/BLOCKED/HUMAN_REVIEW AgentRun counts once; dependency failures, cancelled, incomplete and future sessions are excluded. Day and last interaction use ended_at, in the persisted Elder timezone. No transcript, model output or global total.

care_unit_name.description: Care unit this authorization runs through, or null when the authorizing record names no care unit.

open_care_action_count.description: Formal OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/POSTPONED actions across assignees for this elder. Null or absent without professional care_action:read access. Excludes candidates and terminal actions; not a global total.

pending_event_review_count.description: Current CANDIDATE/NEEDS_REVIEW events for this elder, not event versions. Null or absent without professional care_event:read AND care_event:review access; always null for family. Excludes formal, rejected, excluded and deleted events. Not a global total.

interaction_metrics.description: Null or absent without professional voice_session:read permission. A permitted elder with no qualifying sessions has today_count=0 and last_interaction_at=null. Snapshot does not authorize future reads.

daily_summary.description: Null/absent when unavailable, always null for family. Professional summary:read required; metadata only, no summary text or source event identifiers. Navigation reauthorizes independently.

authorization_summary.description: Short description of why the elder is visible. Must not disclose other actors' identities.
